label: c at original positions 4-6 in b-initial sequences with l/s seen (weak)
explanation: Very sparse feature (~0.0016% of steps, ~200 sequences per 1M). It fires only in the original phase or on the delimiter, at steps 4-6, and never during copy. It is enriched for: first token b (85% of mass), input token c (56% of mass), and l/s/x appearing one or two steps earlier (l alone is about 20x lift). The top activations are c right after runs of l, e.g. a q l l l [c] and b k a l l d [c]. Each of these factors is common by itself, and their conjunction still has low precision: the best predicate gets F1 about 0.22 on dev and covers about a third of the mass. The broad version (b-initial sequence, l seen, steps 4-6) covers 77% of the mass at only 1.5% precision. Many activations are not on c: k, j, z, and <DEL> when the next output is b. No coherent single rule found.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 30 cues. Raise it: orig0=b (+4.25), prev_tok=l (+2.50), prev2_tok=l (+2.44), orig2=l (+1.75), prev3_tok=l (+1.73), recall_idx=-1 & in_tok=c (+1.62). Lower it: prev3_tok=- (-1.81), phase=2 (-1.47), in_first=0 (-1.01), t=3 (-0.96).
